mapper.sql: id::text as "fileId", version_id::text as "versionId", relative_path as "relativePath", expected_bytes as bytes, expected_sha256 as sha256, status, failure_reason as "failureReason", attempts
mapper.select: select from ar_version_file where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid) order by relative_path,id
select from ar_version_file where version_id=cast(#{versionId} as uuid) and id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.insert:
insert into ar_version_file(id,version_id,relative_path,expected_bytes,expected_sha256,storage_key, creator_id,creator_name,last_actor_id,last_actor_name) values
(cast(#{f.id} as uuid),cast(#{f.versionId} as uuid),#{f.path},#{f.bytes},#{f.sha256}, #{f.id} || '.bin',#{f.actor},#{f.actorName},#{f.actor},#{f.actorName})
mapper.update: update ar_version_file set status='UPLOADING',failure_reason=null,verified_bytes=null,verified_sha256=null, attempts=attempts+1,last_actor_id=#{actor},last_actor_name=#{actorName},updated_at=now() where id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.select: select v.scene_id::text as "sceneId",f.last_actor_id as "actorId",f.last_actor_name as "actorName" from ar_version_file f join ar_scene_version v on v.id=f.version_id where f.id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.update: update ar_version_file set status=#{status},verified_bytes=case when #{available} then expected_bytes else null end, verified_sha256=case when #{available} then expected_sha256 else null end, failure_reason=#{reason},updated_at=now() where id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.select: select count(*) from ar_version_file where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
select id::text from ar_version_file where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid) order by id
mapper.delete: delete from ar_version_file where version_id=cast(#{id} as uuid)
mapper.select: select from ar_version_file where id>cast(#{cursor} as uuid) and status in ('PENDING','UPLOADING','FAILED') and not exists(select 1 from ar_version_deletion d where d.version_id=ar_version_file.version_id and d.completed_at is null) order by id limit 100
